title: Selfkin Envelope (v0.1)
description: Common signed message structure for Selfkin communication (SK-COM section A5). Every message except F5 advertisements (SK-COM section A3) and F7 media frames after stream setup (SK-COM section A4) uses it. Requested actions go in instructions; content goes in data, which is always untrusted and never grants authority (SK-COM section A5, A7). Receivers MUST reject envelopes that are unsigned, expired, replayed, not addressed to them (aud), out of sequence beyond the configured window, or of an unknown major version; this schema checks structure only, and freshness, replay, and signature checks are the receiver's job. Unknown members outside ext are rejected (fail closed, SK-COM section A5.2). Status: Draft, not for implementation.

form.description: Communication form (SK-COM section A1). F5 is excluded because discovery advertisements are not envelopes; the form of an advertisement is recorded in the advertisement itself.

aud.description: Exactly one intended recipient: an agent, device, or provider identity, or the identifier of an MLS group the sender belongs to (SK-COM section A5).

seq.description: Sequence number within the session (SK-COM section A9).

attestation_ref.description: Reference to the device's attestation or profile claim. Always present; null unless the session was negotiated at C3, where it MUST NOT be null (SK-COM section A5). The negotiated profile is bound to the session by the signed negotiation transcript (SK-COM section B7), so the receiver checks this, not the schema.

cap_token.description: Capability token authorising this message (SK-COM section A6). Required on every envelope except pairing messages (sk.pairing.*) and refusals (sk.refused). Either a Selfkin capability token, or another attenuable token format wrapped with its format name; the receiver MUST verify attenuation for that format natively or refuse with unsupported-token-format.

format.description: Registered name of an attenuable token format.

intent.description: Declared purpose from registries/intents.md (SK-COM section A5).

instructions.description: Requested action, structured. Authenticated only by the envelope signature (sig); there is no separate signature (SK-COM section A5.1).

consequential.description: Sender's declaration that the action is consequential (SK-RT section 1). The receiver decides independently; a false value never skips approval.

data.description: Payload content. Always untrusted data. The receiving Core MUST NOT grant authority based on anything inside data (SK-COM section A5).

payload_type.description: Media type (RFC 6838) or schema URI of data. Required when data is present.

residency.description: Residency tags (SK-RT section 11) and data classes (registries/data-classes.md) of the content. Several tags combine by intersection: the content may only go where every tag allows. An empty tags list means the owner set no residency restriction for this content; all other egress rules still apply.

idem_key.description: Idempotency key; receivers execute each idem_key at most once (SK-COM section A9). Required whenever instructions is present (SK-COM section A5); MAY be used on other messages.

expires.description: Expiry; store-and-forward queues MUST respect it (SK-COM section A9). Must be later than issued (checked by tools/validate).

provenance.description: Chain of prior hops, oldest first (SK-COM section A5): senders, delegators, proxies, relays, and legacy endpoints. Empty if there is no prior hop. Legacy endpoints carry their legacy and unattested labels here (SK-COM section B1, B5).

model_ref.description: Which agent and model produced the content (SK-COM section A5, A10; SK-RT section 14). Required when a model produced content.

sig.description: Signature by the sending agent key over the canonical form of the envelope without sig.

allOf.description: Pairing messages and refusals may omit cap_token and never carry instructions (SK-COM section A3, A5, A7). Every other envelope carries cap_token.
A refusal carries a refusal object as data (SK-COM section A7).

role.description: origin: an earlier sender whose message is being forwarded. delegator: a runtime that delegated the task (F6). proxy: a runtime translating for a legacy endpoint (Method 4). relay / store-and-forward: infrastructure (F8, F9). legacy-endpoint: the legacy endpoint behind a proxy or adapter.

method.description: Legacy compatibility method used at this hop (SK-COM Part B).

allOf.description: SK-COM section B1, B5: every legacy endpoint is labelled legacy and unattested in the envelope.

provider.description: Provider identity, or absent for local inference.

region.description: Region where the model ran (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code or provider region name).

weights_digest.description: Hash of the model weights for local models (SK-RT section 3).
